title: Alien Exodus - RTS (v2)
description: Build your base, harvest mana crystals, train units, and destroy the alien hive in this real-time strategy game.
prompt:
there is no way to build new buildings, there should be buttons to build all these

multiple buildings and units.
Buildings (defined in BUILDING_DEFS)

    Command Center — produces: harvester, refinery, barracks, powerPlant, turret
    Refinery — no production, gives harvest bonus
    Barracks — produces: marine, sniper, grenadier
    Power Plant — no production, gives power bonus (speeds up production)
    Vehicle Depot — produces: scoutJeep, tank, mechWalker (requires Power Plant tech)
    Turret — no production, auto-attacks enemies

Units (defined in UNIT_DEFS)

    Harvester — gathers crystals for credits
    Marine — basic infantry
    Sniper — long-range, high damage
    Grenadier — area-of-effect damage
    Scout Jeep — fast vehicle
    Tank — heavy vehicle, high damage
    Mech Walker — medium vehicle

Buildings are placed by clicking a production button (e.g. from the Command Center) which enters placement mode, then left-clicking on a valid location. Units are queued from the production panel of the appropriate building.
